title: Mini Meatball Subs
description: This mini meatball subs recipe with ground beef, buttery crackers, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, red sauce, and cheese is perfect for entertaining.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Combine ground beef, onion, bell pepper, crackers, and egg in a large bowl; season with Worcestershire sauce, garlic, seasoned salt, and black pepper. Mix well; shape into 8 meatballs. Place in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat spaghetti sauce in a large saucepan over low heat; bring to a simmer. Add meatballs to sauce; simmer until meatballs are fully cooked, about 20 minutes. Do not turn oven off.
Place 1 meatball and some sauce in each roll; divide and sprinkle each with mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Place sandwiches on a baking sheet; bake until cheeses melt, about 7 minutes.

video.description: Keep the party fueled and fun with these awesome mini sub sandwiches! Make zesty meatballs by combining ground beef with onion, green pepper, crackers and egg. Mix in Worcestershire sauce, garlic, seasoned salt and black pepper. Form into meatballs, bake, then add to simmering spaghetti sauce. Open dinner rolls and add a big meatball, sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses, dollop with sauce and bake until cheese melts, then score a flavor touchdown with the crowd!
